summary: Changed all three effect-status SVG imports to raw local assets and encoded them as inline data URLs in the application entry.
Advanced the service-worker shell cache generation and documented that the cached app entry contains the effect-status assets.
Extended the existing effect-status browser coverage to reload a persisted Active Match offline and check that the rendered icon decodes.
rationale: Inline raw imports remove runtime icon requests and keep the existing app.js shell entry as the single cache-status dependency.
The cache-generation change makes deployed clients refresh the shell entry after this asset contract changes while preserving navigation, fetch fallback, and shell-status behavior.
